https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides an environment for automating, managing, and scaling development and testing workflows with ephemeral environments tailored for DevOps and agile teams.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create and launch ephemeral environments for development and testing purposes.
Users must be able to integrate the platform with their existing CI/CD pipelines for automated workflows.
Users must be able to manage multiple projects and environments through a centralized dashboard.
Users must be able to view real-time status and logs of environments for monitoring and debugging purposes.
Users must be able to configure environment parameters, such as resource allocation and dependencies, during setup.
Users must be able to invite team members and assign roles with specific permissions for collaboration.
Users must be able to delete or terminate environments when they are no longer needed to optimize resource usage.
